name: Stacking and mean profiles
description: Stack aligned cutouts at a position list or catalog selection: sub-pixel alignment, optional rotation / rescaling, background, mask handling (input mask, catalog neighbours, per-cutout detections), mean / median / weighted / clipped combination with bootstrap errors over the sources, radial surface-brightness profile, aperture flux, and a null stack of random blank positions for the residual bias. For faint-source stacks (mean flux below the detection limit) and low-surface-brightness halos.

params.name: positions
params.label: Position list (optional)
params.help: Text/TSV/CSV file with X_IMAGE,Y_IMAGE (1-based), x,y, or RA,DEC (deg) columns; empty = use the catalog rows selected below.

params.name: numbers
params.label: Catalog NUMBERs
params.help: Restrict to these catalog objects, e.g. 1,5,7-9 (empty = all).

params.name: sel-col
params.label: Selection column
params.help: Catalog column used by the range below (e.g. MAG_AUTO, FLUX_RADIUS). Ignored when the range is open.

params.name: sel-min
params.label: Selection minimum
params.help: Keep rows with column >= this value.

params.name: sel-max
params.label: Selection maximum
params.help: Keep rows with column <= this value.

params.name: isolate
params.label: Isolation radius (px, 0 = off)
params.help: Reject sources that have another catalog object closer than this.

params.name: half
params.label: Cutout half size (px)
params.help: Cutouts are (2 half + 1)^2 pixels; with a size column they are in units of size/scale-unit.

params.name: align
params.label: Alignment
params.help: sub = spline resampling on the true sub-pixel position (sharp stack, correlates the noise: bootstrap errors include it); int = integer shift (no resampling, centre smeared by up to 0.5 px).

params.name: scale-col
params.label: Size column (rescale)
params.help: Catalog column (px) used to rescale each cutout to a common size (e.g. FLUX_RADIUS); empty = no rescaling. Surface brightness is conserved.

params.name: scale-unit
params.label: Output px per size
params.help: With a size column, one size unit = this many output pixels.

params.name: angle-col
params.label: Angle column (rotate)
params.help: Catalog column with the position angle in degrees from +x (e.g. THETA_IMAGE); the cutouts are rotated so the major axes line up. Empty = no rotation.

params.name: bkg
params.label: Background
params.help: annulus = sigma-clipped median in the outer ring of each cutout (do not use for halos reaching the cutout edge); none = image already sky-subtracted; image = subtract the background map below.

params.name: bkg-in
params.label: Annulus inner fraction
params.help: Inner radius of the background ring as a fraction of the half size.

params.name: bkg-file
params.label: Background map (optional)
params.help: FITS background map (e.g. the noise-model background) subtracted when Background = image.

params.name: mask-catalog
params.label: Mask catalog neighbours (x extent, 0 = off)
params.help: Masks every other catalog object with a circle of radius max(min, factor x A_IMAGE x KRON_RADIUS).

params.name: mask-detect
params.label: Mask detections per cutout (sigma, 0 = off)
params.help: Masks (grown) smoothed peaks above this many sigma in each cutout outside the protected core: removes unlisted neighbours so that faint halos remain; biases the level low - use the null stack to correct.

params.name: protect-r
params.label: Protected core radius (px)
params.help: Detections touching this radius around the target are never masked.

params.name: min-valid
params.label: Minimum valid fraction
params.help: Cutouts with more masked pixels than this are rejected.

params.name: method
params.label: Combination
params.help: mean | median | wmean (inverse-variance or column weights) | clipmean (sigma clipped).

params.name: norm
params.label: Normalisation
params.help: none | flux (aperture flux within the normalisation radius becomes 1) | peak | column.

params.name: norm-col
params.label: Normalisation column
params.help: Catalog column multiplied into each cutout when Normalisation = column.

params.name: weights
params.label: Weights
params.help: invvar = inverse variance from the cutout ring; column = weight column (use with Combination = wmean).

params.name: n-boot
params.label: Bootstrap resamples
params.help: Resamplings of the source list for the errors of the stack, profile and aperture flux (the median is slow for thousands of sources).

params.name: null
params.label: Null stack positions (0 = off)
params.help: Number of random blank-sky positions stacked with exactly the same pipeline: measures the residual background / mask bias.

params.name: subtract-null
params.label: Subtract the null stack
params.help: Profile and aperture flux are corrected by the null stack (errors in quadrature).

params.name: q
params.label: Profile axis ratio
params.help: Elliptical annuli of the profile (use with rotation to the major axis).

params.name: ap-r
params.label: Aperture radius (px)
params.help: Radius of the aperture flux of the stack.

params.name: estimator
params.label: Profile estimator
params.help: Mean or median of the stack pixels in each annulus.

params.name: rlin
params.label: Linear bins up to (px)
params.help: 1-px bins up to this radius, then geometric bins.

params.name: save-cube
params.label: Save the aligned cutouts
params.help: Write stacking_cutouts.fits (N x S x S).

params.name: psf-stamp
params.label: Write the stack as a PSF stamp
params.help: Treat the selected sources as stars: write stacking_psf.fits, the median stack of recentred stamps with azimuthally averaged wings and unit sum (a PSF image for multifit / PSF photometry).

params.name: show-stack
params.label: Open the stack in a frame
params.help: Load stacking_stack.fits into a new frame after the run.

params.name: seed
params.label: Random seed
params.help: Bootstrap and null positions.
